messages.content: Hey, so Boss Zhang just pulled me aside to talk about the roster for the Shenzhen trip again.

messages.content: Hey, so Boss Zhang updated the roster for the Shenzhen trip today. Wanghao is actually coming with me for exactly one day to handle a VIP client.

She's doing a bit better. She told me she felt cautiously optimistic because Wanghao is partially back on the Shenzhen trip roster, which slightly eases her on-call anxiety.
That's good to hear. Even one day of backup is better than being completely solo. Has she asked to go over the handover details yet?
Yeah, she scheduled a quick sync meeting for the Shenzhen trip at 2:00 PM today. She also noted that 3 critical microservices need extra monitoring while I'm away.
Makes sense to pinpoint the high-risk areas early. Is she doing anything else to manage her workload while you're both traveling?
She decided to order takeout every night to save time during the Shenzhen trip. She just wants to survive the on-call shifts without having to worry about cooking.
Honestly, that's a brilliant survival strategy. Less time cooking means more time to breathe if those microservices start acting up. Need me to prep any notes for your 2:00 PM sync?

messages.content: Hey, can we update our apartment hunting notes? Liwei and I were just talking about the budget again.

Got it, locking in a strict cap of a 5500 RMB increase. Hopefully, that extra bit opens up some better options for you both. How's the actual search going?
Exhausting, honestly. Liwei noted that we have viewed exactly 14 units so far. It's becoming a blur. But she just scheduled the next viewing for 6:00 PM on Thursday.
14 units is a ton of legwork! I'll add a quick reminder for Thursday at 6:00 PM so you don't double-book yourself. Any new criteria for this next place?

Not really, just hoping it's the one. Oh, one random thing—Liwei decided we should definitely buy new blackout curtains after the apartment hunting is over, no matter where we end up. Her sleep has been pretty light lately.
Makes total sense. Good sleep is crucial, especially with your early morning running plan. I'll keep my fingers crossed that Thursday's viewing is the winner!

Good point, that can definitely be a big chunk of change upfront. Does this change your timeline? Weren't you trying to sign by next Wednesday?

I actually pushed it back a bit. I promised Mom I will officially sign a lease by next Friday instead of Wednesday for the apartment hunting. It gives Liwei and me a couple of extra days to review the contract properly.
Smart move. No need to rush the paperwork when you're locking down a place. Is your mom planning to come see it once you move in?
Not right away, but she decided to mail me a traditional housewarming gift after the apartment hunting concludes.
That's awesome! Let me know if you need help calculating the deposit budget or scheduling those final walkthroughs.

A strict two-week code freeze makes a lot of sense. That should give everyone plenty of time to stabilize the current build. Anything you need to prep for right away?
Yeah, Boss Zhang scheduled a cross-department kickoff meeting for the Double Eleven sale tomorrow morning. I need to gather some of my architecture notes before then.
